question: Which stable net-charge or sheath-structure association accompanies AuroraPIC's weaker mature critical-window field?

basis.observed_before_declaration: The discrete Poisson reconstruction closes and the boundary drive is at parity. Independent electron/ion Shapley terms are strongly cancellation-conditioned, so only their net-charge combination is suitable for the next physical comparison. No metric declared below has been evaluated on the locked phase-space outputs.
basis.post_hoc_status: This rule is prospective for all declared net-charge, field-cancellation, and phase-resolved sheath-edge reductions; it reuses locked production outputs.

reduction_contract.bounded_charge_separation: (ni-ne)/(ni+ne), required finite where ni+ne is positive
reduction_contract.critical_charge_separation_rms: space/phase RMS of bounded charge separation using piecewise-linear boundary interpolation and trapezoidal integration
reduction_contract.space_charge_field: field from e*(ni-ne), zero Dirichlet boundaries, and the locked common discrete Poisson operator
reduction_contract.boundary_drive_field: field from zero charge and observed endpoint potentials
reduction_contract.left_sheath_width: first left-to-right linearly interpolated ne/ni threshold crossing, measured from x=0, separately in every critical phase bin
reduction_contract.threshold_summary: arithmetic mean of the 25 phase-bin sheath widths
reduction_contract.positive_sheath_charge_C_m2: phase mean of the trapezoidal integral of max(e*(ni-ne),0) from x=0 through the threshold crossing
reduction_contract.native_reference: arithmetic mean of the three member metrics; no elementwise species substitution

prospective_decision_rule.shape_and_crossing_gate: all matrices have the locked shape, all values are finite, every critical phase has all three crossings, and widths are nondecreasing from threshold 0.8 through 0.95
prospective_decision_rule.positive_metric_gate: charge-separation RMS, cancellation fraction, sheath widths, and positive sheath charges are positive for every member
prospective_decision_rule.aurorapic_repeatability_gate: relative two-member range no greater than 0.10 for every declared summary metric
prospective_decision_rule.native_repeatability_gate: relative three-member range no greater than 0.15 for every declared summary metric
prospective_decision_rule.stronger_space_charge_cancellation_suppo: both AuroraPIC/native cancellation-fraction ratios are at least 1.10
prospective_decision_rule.larger_charge_separation_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native critical charge-separation-RMS ratios are at least 1.10
prospective_decision_rule.wider_left_sheath_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native mean-width ratios are at least 1.10 at all three thresholds
prospective_decision_rule.lower_positive_sheath_charge_supported_i: both AuroraPIC/native mean positive-sheath-charge ratios are at most 0.90 at all three thresholds

claim_boundary: These threshold-sensitive sheath proxies and net-charge metrics characterize one mature left-sheath phase/window. They do not define a unique sheath edge, identify the first temporal divergence, turn algebraic association into causation, compare experiment, establish a published benchmark pass, or prove general PIC correctness.
